en: Black‑and‑white interior view of an elegant early‑20th‑century theater café and restaurant with many neatly arranged tables covered with white tablecloths, wooden chairs, decorated columns, and ceiling lights. At the back there is a small stage with musical instruments. Along the bottom border is printed German text identifying the venue as Theater Café and Restaurant in Hotel Goldne Sonne in Meißen and giving a telephone number.
